noticias.titular: A search tool shows whether a digital tool meets the INTEF’s guidelines
noticias.entradilla: The guide uses a traffic-light system to classify the 1,144 tools analysed by the INTEF.
noticias.imagen_alt: A traffic light with three lights: the red one, labelled “Do not use”; the amber one, labelled “With school permission”; and the green one, labelled “Can be used”. On the right, a list with a magnifying glass and the label “1,144 tools”.

noticias.titular: South Korea’s education minister resigns over measures against AI cheating
noticias.entradilla: Last-minute changes to prevent the use of AI in the national university entrance exam caused difficulties for students and teachers.
noticias.imagen_alt: Three steps from left to right: a pencil labelled “Pencil only”, a mobile phone crossed out with a red line and labelled “No phones”, and a person labelled “Resignation”.

noticias.titular: A comparison tool helps you choose which free chatbot suits your needs
noticias.entradilla: Juan José de Haro created a web app where you rate the importance of each feature and get a personalised ranking of free chatbots.
noticias.imagen_alt: Two columns: on the left, sliders for the importance of each feature; on the right, the ranking of chatbots with percentages, led by Qwen on 91%.

noticias.titular: Affinity brings photo editing, vector drawing and page layout together in one free program
noticias.entradilla: It is useful for retouching and composing images generated with AI. Its official website presents it as free for individuals, with the AI features available only on Canva’s paid plans.
noticias.imagen_alt: Loose, tilted images, labelled “Loose”, pass through three tools, a brush (“Photo”), a pen (“Vectors”) and a grid (“Layout”), which converge in a single window where a poster page remains, with a title, two images and a caption, labelled “Poster”.

noticias.titular: Opus 4.5 scored above 80% on a coding test that OpenAI no longer uses
noticias.entradilla: In November 2025, a record on a coding benchmark was celebrated as a sign that AI had no ceiling. Three months later, OpenAI stopped publishing results on it, calling it flawed and contaminated.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diptych split by a vertical line. On the left, “Nov. 2025”: a code file with a verification seal and the labels “SWE-bench” and “Record”. On the right, “Today”: the same file with a blue prohibition symbol and the label “Withdrawn”.

noticias.titular: Raül Torres has come off the waiting list for Project Genie, the Google model that creates interactive…
noticias.entradilla: Raül Torres has come off the waiting list for Project Genie, the Google model that creates interactive worlds, and has access through his Google AI Pro subscription, as the paper reported when presenting Genie 4.

noticias.titular: An imagined case asks who signs a prize-winning story illustrated with AI
noticias.entradilla: An instalment of the series “Familias con inteligencia” imagines a case: a student declares that they used AI, wins a competition and a classmate challenges it. Chema Falcó asks schools for clear criteria.
noticias.imagen_alt: Three labels, “Text”, “Creative direction” and “Execution”, grouped by a brace that points to a book labelled “Story”; below, a notice with a medal and the label “Competition rules”, with a dashed red arrow towards the story.

noticias.titular: An app turns spoken answers into assessment reports for families
noticias.entradilla: “Informes a viva voz”, by Ernesto Boixader, asks teachers to answer three or seven questions about each student, and AI writes the report from those answers.
noticias.imagen_alt: A microphone labelled “Voice”, with the label “3 or 7 questions”, an arrow to a robot labelled “AI writes” and another to a document labelled “Report”; below, a person with the label “Teacher reviews”.

noticias.titular: Raül Torres releases his short film “Buzz” and explains step by step how he made it
noticias.entradilla: The director explains on a web page and in a video how he shot it by hand in virtual reality and left only the developing of the images to AI.
noticias.imagen_alt: A chain of four steps with arrows: a cube labelled “3D set”, virtual reality glasses labelled “Shot by hand”, a robot labelled “AI develops” and a clapperboard labelled “Buzz”; beneath the two middle steps, a dashed red bracket.

noticias.titular: An editor that turns ABC notation into a score and plays it in the browser
noticias.entradilla: María Teresa González created a simple music editor: you type the melody as text, the score appears and you can listen to it, with nothing to install.
noticias.imagen_alt: Editor with a text box in ABC notation on the left and, on the right, the audio controls and the score of a C major scale.

noticias.titular: Google offered Opal for building apps without coding; a year later it has shut it down
noticias.entradilla: In November 2025, Google offered Opal for free, a tool for building apps with AI without knowing how to code. It shut it down on 17 November 2026, and what people made with it does not move to Gemini on its own.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diptych split by a vertical line. On the left, labelled “Nov. 2025”, an app window labelled “Opal”. On the right, labelled “Today”, the same window crossed out with a red cross and labelled “Closed”, and a blue arrow pointing to a forward-slash icon labelled “Skills”.

noticias.titular: AI helps learning more when it is used to understand than when it does the task
noticias.entradilla: A review by Stanford University now brings together 52 studies measuring the effect of AI on learning: using it to understand new material fares better than using it to produce the work, although no use improves results consistently. This report explains how to read those studies, why a tutor that asks questions is not enough on its own and what a teacher can do so that AI does not do the students’ work.
noticias.imagen_alt: Infographic: a student facing an AI assistant with two paths. At the top, “Hand in”: the AI does the work and, without the tool, the result falls: “Without the tool: −17%”. Below, “Understand”: the assistant asks questions and the student corrects their own errors: “64% self-corrected”. Underneath, four recommendations: “Try it first”, “Tutor asks”, “Split the tasks” and “Check without AI”.

noticias.titular: Gemini Notebook now has an official API, though limited and in preview
noticias.entradilla: It lets other programs create notebooks and add sources to them, but only with personal accounts. An unofficial code library does more, although it may stop working without warning.
noticias.imagen_alt: A diagram of two paths to the same notebook: the upper one, labelled “Official API”, passes through a padlock and carries the label “Personal only”; the lower one, labelled “Unofficial”, is a dashed red line with the label “May break”. On the right, the notebook, labelled “Notebook”.

noticias.titular: Android lets you share your own app with up to 50 devices without Google Play
noticias.entradilla: The limited distribution account is free and is intended for people who build apps for a class or a small group.
noticias.imagen_alt: A QR code, labelled “QR code”, with an arrow towards a grid of phones followed by an ellipsis and the label “Up to 50 devices”; below, a red cross and the label “No Google Play”.

noticias.titular: An Argentine handbook brings the environmental, labour and social costs of AI into the classroom
noticias.entradilla: Two researchers propose that secondary school teachers ask what for, from where and with what consequences artificial intelligence is used, before deciding how. The 2026 handbook takes a Latin American and feminist perspective.
noticias.imagen_alt: Layered diagram: a screen labelled “AI assistant” rests on three stacked layers, “Decisions”, “Data centres” and “Labelling”, while a magnifying glass descends through them beside a red arrow and the question “With what consequences?”.

noticias.titular: Since October, Gemini has offered visual, interactive tours of topics for studying
noticias.entradilla: Immersive explorations are a library of ready-made topics explored layer by layer. According to the group, you cannot create your own topics, and the experience is available in only six languages, not including Spanish.
noticias.imagen_alt: On the left, concentric circles like layers to be explored, labelled “In layers”; on the right, a globe crossed out with a red line, with the labels “6 languages” and “No Spanish”.

noticias.titular: A simulator lets you build Rube Goldberg machines and analyse their levers
noticias.entradilla: Students place pieces on a board, set the chain going and check the fulcrum, load and force of each simple machine. It is in Catalan.
noticias.imagen_alt: A lever on a triangular fulcrum, labelled “Fulcrum”; on the left, a red downward arrow labelled “Force”, and on the right, a block on the lever labelled “Load”.

noticias.titular: The image model that drew a nine-sided shape with eleven sides has been replaced in Gemini
noticias.entradilla: In November 2025, Google’s new image model got some polygons right and others wrong. In February 2026 Nano Banana 2 replaced it in Gemini, and for developers there is another that costs a quarter as much per 1K image.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diptych split by a vertical line. On the left, “Nov. 2025”: four ink-coloured banknotes and below them “$0.134”. On the right, “Today”: a single blue banknote, a quarter as many, and below it “$0.0336”.

noticias.titular: Google DeepMind offers, in English, an interactive guide that uses its Gemma 4 model to explain how a…
noticias.entradilla: Google DeepMind offers, in English, an interactive guide that uses its Gemma 4 model to explain how a language model, the kind of program behind ChatGPT, generates from a text the fragment that comes next. It goes through five stages, from splitting the text to the chat format.

noticias.titular: The Council of the EU approves conclusions on citizens’ AI skills
noticias.entradilla: Member states back the idea that people of all ages should learn to use artificial intelligence critically and responsibly. These are policy guidelines, not a rule that binds schools.
noticias.imagen_alt: A diagram of three steps joined by arrows: a building with columns, “European framework”; a flag, “Each state”; and an open book, “Classrooms”. The dotted red arrow between the last two is labelled “Guidance only”.

noticias.titular: Chicago weighs its options if Google withdraws search from districts that reject its AI
noticias.entradilla: According to the Chicago Sun-Times, Google warns that school districts that do not allow its AI tools will lose access to search next year.
noticias.imagen_alt: A building, “District”, with an arrow labelled “Rejects AI” pointing to a magnifying glass crossed out with a red circle, “Search”, and below it the question “No access?”.

noticias.titular: A Catalan-language train puzzle for planning shunting moves is new in the repository
noticias.entradilla: The Vibe Coding Educativo resource repository adds eight resources in the week ending 20 November: one is presented here and seven have already had their own article.
noticias.imagen_alt: Welcome screen of the game over a track layout with colourful numbered wagons, with a field for typing a player name.

noticias.titular: Manchester Animation Festival will not accept films made with generative AI from 2027
noticias.entradilla: The British festival announced it on 13 November together with this year’s awards. Its director presents it as a way of backing animation artists.
noticias.imagen_alt: A film clapperboard, “AI film”, with an arrow labelled “From 2027” cut by a red bar that does not reach the building with columns, “Festival”.

noticias.titular: Trama adds readings grouped into “universes” and versions of different difficulty
noticias.entradilla: The reading-comprehension catalogue lets you choose readings that share the same world and versions of the same text at different levels. Its author asks for help translating it into Galician, Basque and Aranese.
noticias.imagen_alt: On the left, three open books inside a dotted circle, “Universe”; on the right, three stacked sheets with lines of text of different lengths, “Variants”.

noticias.titular: From 9% to 36% in research-level physics: AI still fails almost two in three
noticias.entradilla: In November 2025 a new evaluation of unseen physics problems was launched, and no AI model reached 10%. A year later, the best result is close to 36%.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diptych in two halves. On the left, labelled “Nov. 2025”, a sheet with three physics challenges, all three crossed out, and the label “Fails almost everything”. On the right, labelled “Today”, the same sheet with the first challenge solved, with a blue mark, and the other two still crossed out, with the label “Still fails a lot”.

noticias.titular: Gemini will separate conversation history from permission to train models
noticias.entradilla: Google will replace the “Keep Activity” setting with two: one for history and, separately, one that lets its models use the content of conversations.
noticias.imagen_alt: A switch labelled “Keep Activity” splits, with two arrows, into two independent settings: “History”, with a calendar and a switch, and “Training”, with a cogwheel and another switch.

noticias.titular: Google AI Studio builds complete Android apps from a description
noticias.entradilla: It generates Kotlin apps with sign-in and a database, tests them in an in-browser emulator and lets you install them from your personal Google Play library.
noticias.imagen_alt: A speech bubble labelled “Description” leads, with an arrow, to a browser window with a phone inside, labelled “Emulator”, and from there, with another arrow, to a box with a play symbol, labelled “Google Play”.

noticias.titular: Genie 4 comes to Project Genie: interactive worlds that change as you explore them
noticias.entradilla: Access starts with Google AI Ultra, and AI Pro subscribers can join a waiting list.
noticias.imagen_alt: Two framed landscapes, labelled “World” and “Modified”: the first, with mountains and a sun; the second, the same mountains with a cloud and rain. Between them, an arrow labelled “New command” with a speech bubble below.

noticias.titular: Canada launches a national AI literacy initiative with three strands: students, teachers and the public
noticias.entradilla: The Canadian government has launched, with the Amii institute, a national AI literacy initiative with three training strands, one of them yet to launch. The document shared in the library presents it and points out its shortcomings.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diagram: a box on the left, “AI literacy”, from which three paths lead, each with an icon: a graduation cap labelled “Students”, a whiteboard labelled “Teachers” and a group of people labelled “Citizens”; beneath the last one, a dashed line labelled “Yet to launch”.

noticias.titular: The 1994 Clark–Kozma debate helps in reading Stanford’s studies on AI
noticias.entradilla: An academic argument over whether technology influences learning or only the method matters, recalled in the group in connection with Stanford’s review.
noticias.imagen_alt: A drawing divided into two halves. On the left, a package labelled “Method” on a lorry labelled “Medium”, with the name “Clark”: the medium only carries the method. On the right, two overlapping circles, with the name “Kozma”: medium and method cannot be separated.

noticias.titular: A teacher reflective journal with AI raises the question of whether the assistant supports or replaces judgement
noticias.entradilla: A master’s thesis project proposes dictating after each class and having an assistant organise the text and return questions; the group debates whether that weakens judgement.
noticias.imagen_alt: A microphone labelled “Dictation” leads to a document labelled “Summary” and to a speech bubble with a question mark labelled “Questions”. An arrow goes down from the document to a box labelled “The teacher decides”.

noticias.titular: Free ChatGPT for teachers only in the US: a year on, the border remains
noticias.entradilla: In November 2025, OpenAI launched ChatGPT for Teachers and Spanish teachers wondered whether it would reach them. A year on, it has grown in US schools, but it has not crossed the ocean.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diptych. On the left, “Nov. 2025”: a globe with a single pin on “US” and a closed padlock below. On the right, “Today”: the same globe with three blue pins on “US” and the padlock still closed, next to the label “Spain”.

noticias.titular: Eduvers, the simulation platform that the paper introduced on 12 November, now has “Laboratorio XR: Ensayo…
noticias.entradilla: Eduvers, the simulation platform that the paper introduced on 12 November, now has “Laboratorio XR: Ensayo a la llama” (an XR flame-test lab) and a simulation of the human eye online. The page does not explain the lab’s requirements or say who makes it.

noticias.titular: Stanford gathers 52 causal studies on AI in schools and sees uneven results
noticias.entradilla: The November review goes from 20 to 52 studies and concludes that AI looks more promising for understanding new material than for producing assignments, but no use improves learning consistently.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diagram: a person uses an assistant, from which two paths lead: one towards “Understand” and another, in red, towards “Do the task”, and at the end a balance. Labels: Assistant, Understand, Do the task, Uneven.

noticias.titular: Galicia’s parliament passes the law regulating phones, screens and AI in classrooms
noticias.entradilla: The Digital Education Law limits individual use of devices up to the fifth year of primary school and was passed with the votes of the PPdeG and the opposition of the BNG and the PSdeG.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diagram: a parliament building leads to a law, from which come a phone crossed out in red and a video camera. Labels: Parliament, Digital law, Phones, No recording.

noticias.titular: Madrid adds to EducaMadrid an AI agent that prepares personalised materials
noticias.entradilla: According to the Community of Madrid, the agent was developed by civil servants in its regional digital ministry and can be used by teachers in publicly funded schools.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diagram: a teacher uses an agent, from which three results come: a document, a tick and an envelope. Labels: Teacher, Agent, Notes, Quizzes, Emails.

noticias.titular: Experiment with 400 adults finds a Socratic AI tutor teaches more than explaining the mistake
noticias.entradilla: Carnegie Mellon researchers compare four ways of giving feedback after a mistake and suggest that what works is sending the student back to the task until they get it right.
noticias.imagen_alt: Two paths after a mistake, marked with a red cross. At the top, the mistake leads to a box labelled “Explanation” and from there to the next problems. At the bottom, the mistake leads to “Question”, then to “Retry”, with an arrow returning from “Retry” to “Question” until the answer is right, and finally to a tick under the label “Success”. Above, the label “64%”.

noticias.titular: Suno launches Visuals to create lyric videos and cover art from its songs
noticias.entradilla: The feature generates clips of up to 15 seconds and is paid for with credits separate from those for songs.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diagram: a musical note with three arrows towards three cards: a video clapperboard, an image and a camera. Labels: Song, Lyric video, Cover art, 15 s clip, Credits sold separately.

noticias.titular: A teacher measures the use of their apps with Umami, cookie-free statistics
noticias.entradilla: This tool shows which features students use without collecting names or email addresses.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diagram: an app window with a pointer clicking sends its usage to a dashboard with a crossed-out eye; beside it, a cookie crossed out in red and a flag. Labels: App, Umami, No cookies, Error flag.

noticias.titular: Antigravity buckled under demand at its free launch; a year on, it has paid plans
noticias.entradilla: In November 2025, Google’s agent-based coding environment launched, free and overwhelmed. A year later it is on version 2.32, and extra usage requires a subscription.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diptych with two identical windows. On the left, “Nov. 2025”: a window with a warning triangle and the label “Overloaded”. On the right, “Today”: the same window with a blue padlock and the labels “Weekly limits” and “Pro and Ultra”.

noticias.titular: Google is rolling out temporary threads in AI Mode in its search engine: the questions in those…
noticias.entradilla: Google is rolling out temporary threads in AI Mode in its search engine: the questions in those conversations are not saved in the history or used for personalisation, according to its announcement of 17 November.

noticias.titular: Trama now has 245 reading texts in Catalan and Spanish, from the third year of primary school to the first…
noticias.entradilla: Trama now has 245 reading texts in Catalan and Spanish, from the third year of primary school to the first year of ESO, according to its own website.

noticias.titular: ChatGPT Learn publishes a guide to giving tasks to GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol in Codex, OpenAI’s programming…
noticias.entradilla: ChatGPT Learn publishes a guide to giving tasks to GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol in Codex, OpenAI’s programming assistant; the page does not state a launch date or plans.

noticias.titular: Kling AI announces Kling Image 4.0, with images generated directly in 8K resolution, text in several…
noticias.entradilla: Kling AI announces Kling Image 4.0, with images generated directly in 8K resolution, text in several languages and up to 10 mutually consistent images per request, according to its statement of 17 November; it does not state availability or prices.

noticias.titular: Gemini Notebook turns a notebook’s sources into an interactive website
noticias.entradilla: All it takes is typing “make me a site” in the notebook’s chat. Members of the groups have already tried it, and one has uploaded the result to Moodle.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diagram from left to right: three documents labelled “Sources” go into a notebook with a chat bubble labelled “make me a site”; out of it comes a web page with a panel and lines of text, labelled “Website”, which is downloaded as a “.html” file and uploaded to “Moodle”.

noticias.titular: Three apps in Catalan: a classroom auction and two density labs
noticias.entradilla: Felip Sarroca i Gil shares Subhasta, for working on scarcity and budgeting, and Densitats and Densitat, for studying flotation with Archimedes’ principle.
noticias.imagen_alt: On the left, an auctioneer’s gavel on its block, with coins, labelled “Auction”. On the right, a tank of water in which a block floats, with an upward arrow labelled “Buoyancy” and the label “Flotation”.

noticias.titular: Agente Clima IES analyses classroom temperature and humidity in the browser
noticias.entradilla: The app reads sensor logs and compares them with the limits set by the regulation on workplaces.
noticias.imagen_alt: A document labelled “CSV” passes into a browser window, labelled “In the browser”, containing a thermometer with the label “17–27 °C” and water drops with the label “30–70%”.

noticias.titular: Google Flow will retire Veo 3.1 Fast, Veo 3.1 Quality and Omni Flash 1.1 on 5 December
noticias.entradilla: Flow’s help page recommends moving to Omni Flash 1.2 or Veo 3.1 Lite for future projects.
noticias.imagen_alt: A calendar crossed out in red, labelled “5 Dec”, heads two groups of clapperboards: on the left, three labelled “Being retired”; on the right, two labelled “Omni Flash 1.2” and “Veo 3.1 Lite”, under the label “Staying”.

noticias.titular: Grading a text prepared with AI requires a sample of the student’s own writing
noticias.entradilla: Asking students to explain how they used artificial intelligence makes sense if they know the rules before they start. Giving a mark takes something more, even when the declaration is entirely sincere.

noticias.titular: Scholar Labs goes from a waiting list and English only to opening up in every language
noticias.entradilla: In November 2025, Scholar Labs accepted questions only in English and many people had to join a waiting list. Since June 2026 it has been open to every signed-in user and accepts questions in all languages.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diptych split by a vertical line. On the left, “Nov. 2025”: a closed padlock with the labels “Waiting list” and “English only”. On the right, “Today”: an open padlock, in blue, with the label “All languages” and the translation icon.

noticias.titular: South Korea will check all glasses at the university entrance exam (Suneung) after the top scorer in the…
noticias.entradilla: South Korea will check all glasses at the university entrance exam (Suneung) after the top scorer in the tax accountant exam confessed to using a micro-camera and generative AI to cheat. According to The Next Web, more than 500,000 students sit the exam at 1,300 centres.

noticias.titular: A robotic palletising cell is simulated in the browser and exports the scene as .glb
noticias.entradilla: According to the message of the person who shared it, the app was built with AI models; it lets users stop, resume and monitor a virtual industrial cell and export the scene for Blender.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diagram from left to right: a browser window with a robotic cell (conveyor with boxes, robot arm and pallet) and a vertical red line marking the safety curtain; a blue arrow towards a 3D cube. Labels: “Cell in the browser”, “Light curtain”, “.glb” and “Blender”.

noticias.titular: INTEF updates its guide to AI in education with ten ethical principles and a phased plan for schools to adopt it
noticias.entradilla: Version 2.0 of the Ministry of Education's guide, published in September 2026, organises the use of AI around three profiles (students, teachers and schools) and adds annexes ready for the classroom.
noticias.imagen_alt: Three cards, each with a human figure, labelled “Students”, “Teachers” and “School”, resting on a base labelled “Three profiles”; above the school card a seven-step staircase labelled “Seven phases” rises to a circle with a review arrow.

noticias.titular: Trama offers 206 reading texts with questions for building reading comprehension worksheets
noticias.entradilla: The catalogue, in Catalan and Spanish, is aimed mainly at the fourth to sixth years of primary school and lets teachers choose the questions before printing the worksheet or downloading it as a PDF.
noticias.imagen_alt: Trama's catalogue of reading texts with filters on the left and cards showing an illustration, title, school year, difficulty and a “Prepara la fitxa” button.

noticias.titular: EyeJack Creator: bringing an image to life on your phone with augmented reality
noticias.entradilla: A website lets you attach a video or animation to an image and watch it on your phone by pointing at it. The free version limits views, duration and size.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diagram in two halves. On the left, “Before”: a poster with a drawn sun and mountain, a QR code and a phone pointing at it, labelled “Poster”. On the right, “After”: the same poster with motion lines and a phone showing the animated drawing, labelled “In motion”.

noticias.titular: Failed for studying from flawed ChatGPT notes; today Catalonia has 45 guidelines on use
noticias.entradilla: In November 2025, a Catalan teacher said he had failed students who studied from flawed notes made with ChatGPT, and the group called for literacy and rules. A year later, the Departament d’Educació has set out how AI should enter schools.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diptych split by a vertical line. On the left, “Nov. 2025”: a document crossed out with an X, labelled “Flawed notes”. On the right, “Today”: the same document marked with a blue check mark, labelled “45 guidelines”.

noticias.titular: ElevenLabs’ video translator page advertises more than 90 languages, although its FAQ section speaks of…
noticias.entradilla: ElevenLabs’ video translator page advertises more than 90 languages, although its FAQ section speaks of more than 29 and does not mention Catalan. It states a limit of one minute or 50 MB per file.

noticias.titular: Declaring AI use: a teacher asks schools to clarify which uses are acceptable
noticias.entradilla: A teacher asks whether schools, very focused on detecting AI-generated work, explain clearly enough which uses are acceptable and how to declare them.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diagram with the question “Which uses are allowed?” at the top. On the left, a document with a blue arrow leading to a scale, under the label “Declared process”. On the right, a document with an arrow leading to a red question mark, under the label “Hidden process”.

noticias.titular: Chrome publishes Modern Web Guidance 1.0, a guide to the current web for coding agents
noticias.entradilla: The guide brings together expert-verified solutions and compatibility data to correct the outdated knowledge of models.
noticias.imagen_alt: Three boxes joined by arrows: a file with a clock, labelled “Old data”, an open book guide, labelled “Current web guide”, and a code file with a red tick, labelled “Current code”.

noticias.titular: Battleships in Catalan, against the machine or online with a room code
noticias.entradilla: “Enfonsar la flota” is a web version of the classic battleships game, with a 10×10 board, which works on coordinates and strategy in primary and secondary school.
noticias.imagen_alt: Start screen of the game with two cards: “Partida en línia”, with a button to create a room and a code field, and “Contra la màquina”, with three difficulty levels.

noticias.titular: Antigravity adds Gemini 4 Hydrogen and an Orchestrator mode that shares out the work
noticias.entradilla: Orchestrator combines Hydrogen with more powerful models; access depends on Google’s paid plan.
noticias.imagen_alt: Under the title “Orchestrator”, two boxes: on the left one with a branching diagram, labelled “Carbon plans”, and on the right one with a code file, labelled “Hydrogen edits”. An arrow carries the work from the first to the second and a red arrow goes back, labelled “If it gets stuck”.

noticias.titular: Seedream 5.5 promises to keep an image stable across 100 rounds of editing
noticias.entradilla: ByteDance presents a version of its image generator designed for retouching the same image again and again without changing what is left untouched, and which generates transparent backgrounds.
noticias.imagen_alt: Under the title “Seedream 5.5”, an image passes through circular arrows, labelled “100 rounds”, and comes out the same as it went in. On the right, a blue circle on a background of alternating squares, labelled “Transparent background”.

noticias.titular: Cross-checking several AIs was a homemade trick; today Perplexity does it in a single query
noticias.entradilla: In November 2025, the advice for trusting an answer was to ask two or three artificial intelligences and use another to look for the discrepancies. In February 2026, Perplexity turned that method into a feature.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diptych split by a vertical line. On the left, “Nov. 2025”: three answers from three AIs that a person, drawn with head and shoulders and labelled “By hand”, compares. On the right, “Today”: the same three answers go into a single blue box with two zones, “Agree”, with a tick, and “Differ”.

noticias.titular: According to the Financial Times, reported by Deseret News, Spotify is preparing for early 2027 a paid…
noticias.entradilla: According to the Financial Times, reported by Deseret News, Spotify is preparing for early 2027 a paid add-on ($4 to $5 a month, according to that report) to create AI remixes and covers, with agreements with Universal, Merlin and Believe. Spotify has confirmed neither date nor price; in August it had already announced the project with Universal and Merlin.

noticias.titular: Intelética, IBERAMIA’s open-access journal on artificial intelligence, ethics and society, accepts…
noticias.entradilla: Intelética, IBERAMIA’s open-access journal on artificial intelligence, ethics and society, accepts articles in Spanish, Portuguese and English.

noticias.titular: AI-text detectors are not proof, and institutions propose assessing the process instead
noticias.entradilla: Programs that promise to reveal whether a piece of work was written by artificial intelligence get it wrong, including for students who have not used it, and even their own makers advise against punishing anyone on their say-so. This report explains what the studies, the European Regulation, data protection authorities and education guidelines say, and sets out a no-cost plan for assessing fairly in any subject: state which uses are allowed, ask for evidence of the process and listen to students.
noticias.imagen_alt: Two-column infographic. On the left, under the label “Detector”, a document with a percentage bar and a question mark, and three warnings (an alert triangle, two speech bubbles and a half-and-half box) representing false positives, poorer results in a second language and failures with mixed texts; below, the label “Indication, not proof”. An arrow leads to the right, under the label “Process”, where four steps in a staircase labelled “Declared uses”, “Drafts”, “In stages” and “Oral explanation” lead to a person holding a scale and the label “A person decides”.

noticias.titular: A teacher asks Codex to model Industrial Revolution machines in Blender
noticias.entradilla: Felip Sarroca i Gil says his computer cannot open Blender, but Codex can operate it, and it has generated 3D models for his website for fourth-year ESO students.
noticias.imagen_alt: A diagram from left to right: a speech bubble labelled “Request” leads to a cog labelled “Codex + Blender”, which leads to a cube with three dots labelled “3D model”; a curved red arrow, labelled “More realism”, returns from the model to the request.

noticias.titular: GeoBreath guides breathing exercises with geometric shapes and an adjustable rhythm
noticias.entradilla: Luis Vilela Acuña's app uses an animated shape to show when to breathe in, hold and breathe out. It opens in the browser, with nothing to install, and is available in six languages.
noticias.imagen_alt: GeoBreath screen with a square along whose sides a dot travels, the prompt “Inspira” in the centre, the session and cycle counters and the selector for shape and seconds per side.

noticias.titular: A web editor lets teachers design collectable fauna and flora cards for the classroom
noticias.entradilla: The Eco-Duel Card Generator, created by David Cordones, offers a form for composing cards with data on animals and plants, with one collection per school year, from the first year of primary to the second year of Bachillerato.
noticias.imagen_alt: Card editor with the form on the left and, on the right, a fauna card called Senglar with size 7, level 3 and speed 5, and the buttons Descarregar and Copiar above it.

noticias.titular: Gemini came and went in educational accounts; today the school switches it on or off
noticias.entradilla: In November 2025, anyone using Gemini with an educational account could not tell which features they would find from one day to the next. A year later, Google has opened up features that were then denied to them, but for students’ accounts each school will decide.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diptych split by a vertical line. On the left, “Nov. 2025”: two rows, “Gmail” with a video and a tick, and “XTEC” with a video and a red cross. On the right, “Today”: two school buildings, one with a switch turned on and the other with one turned off, next to the label “School”.

noticias.titular: Eduvers, the simulation platform that the paper presented on 12 November, has a 3D simulation for…
noticias.entradilla: Eduvers, the simulation platform that the paper presented on 12 November, has a 3D simulation for preparing a NaOH solution and measuring the acidity of vinegar, according to its description.

noticias.titular: Wharton releases Primer, an open system that turns a conversation into a simulation
noticias.entradilla: Wharton Generative AI Labs offers an open-source prototype in which a team of agents interviews the teacher and builds a simulation for students. Its authors warn that it has not been evaluated in classrooms.
noticias.imagen_alt: A diagram in two boxes: on the left, a teacher labelled “Teacher” hands over their conversation and receives a document with an approval mark, labelled “Design”; on the right, a student, labelled “Student”, talks to a character, labelled “Character”; below, a red arrow labelled “Report” returns from the simulation to the teacher.

noticias.titular: INTEF to present the 2026 update of its AI guide at SIMO on 13 November
noticias.entradilla: According to INTEF’s programme at SIMO EDUCACIÓN, that day was to see the presentation of the new version of its guide on the use of AI in education and another on how to integrate it into schools.
noticias.imagen_alt: A timeline under the label “13 November” with two sessions: at “10:30”, an open book labelled “AI guide”, and at “13:30”, a document labelled “Schools”.

noticias.titular: Conservatoire regulations, indicators and classroom games, new in the repository
noticias.entradilla: The Vibe Coding Educativo resource repository adds 25 resources this week: 13 are presented here and 12 have already had their own article.
noticias.imagen_alt: Home page of the Legis CPMDEM catalogue with a search box, filters for validity and categories of regulation, and the first entries for decrees and orders.

noticias.titular: ElevenLabs’ Scribe v3 cuts Spanish errors by 35%, according to the company
noticias.entradilla: ElevenLabs’ new speech-to-text models reduce word errors compared with Scribe v2. The figures are the company’s own.
noticias.imagen_alt: On the left, a sound wave labelled “Voice” turns into a sheet with lines of text labelled “Text”; on the right, two columns labelled “Scribe v2” and “Scribe v3”, the second one shorter, with a red downward arrow and the label “−35%”.

noticias.titular: Atlas en xogo, a map game in Galician, joins EDUmind’s apps
noticias.entradilla: A new interactive geography app in Galician has been shared in Vibe Coding Educativo. A full description of its game modes could not be checked.
noticias.imagen_alt: A browser window with a map and the label “Atlas en xogo”; to its left, a magnifying glass with a plus sign, labelled “Zoom”; to its right, a globe labelled “3D view”.

noticias.titular: Disney was going to open its characters to AI; Sora shut down before the money arrived
noticias.entradilla: In November 2025 it was being said that Disney would allow content to be created with its characters, and the end of generative AI’s “free-for-all” was being predicted. The deal came in December, with Sora; in March, OpenAI shut Sora down and the deal fell apart.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diptych in two halves. On the left, “Nov. 2025”: a film clapperboard and a coin with a dollar sign, under the label “Licence”. On the right, “Today”: the same clapperboard and the same coin crossed out with blue lines, under the label “Closed”.

noticias.titular: Microsoft unveils Classroom, a dedicated space to centre classwork on Microsoft 365
noticias.entradilla: Microsoft Classroom brings assignments, grades and AI tools together on a single screen for primary, secondary and higher education. It arrives in 2027 at no extra cost for schools on certain plans.
noticias.imagen_alt: A panel labelled “Classroom” with four arrows leading to four boxes labelled “Tasks”, “Grades”, “Notebook” and “AI”.

noticias.titular: England's university regulator calls for more assessment without AI and reopens the debate on how to verify authorship
noticias.entradilla: The Office for Students recommends secure formats such as in-person or oral exams. In the group, members debated what can and cannot be detected.
noticias.imagen_alt: A diagram in two halves: on the left, under the label “Secure formats”, three icons labelled “Oral” (a microphone), “Presentation” (a whiteboard) and “Practical” (a pencil); on the right, a magnifying glass crossed out in red with the label “Detector”.

noticias.titular: Relleu Obert turns a piece of real map into a 3D model that can be printed for the classroom
noticias.entradilla: A free, open-source project lets you pick a place, generate its relief in the browser and export it for 3D printing.
noticias.imagen_alt: Three steps joined by arrows: a map labelled “Map”, a mountain labelled “Relief” and a printer labelled “Model”.

noticias.titular: UNESCO proposes five units for students aged 13 to 15 to question AI’s answers and decide for themselves
noticias.entradilla: “AI answers. You decide” is a companion guide to UNESCO’s media and information literacy curriculum, with classroom discussions and activities that can be used separately.
noticias.imagen_alt: A diagram of three concentric circles: “You” in the centre, “AI systems” around it and “People and institutions” in the outer ring; two curved arrows link the first two and a red arrow points from outside to the question “Where can I have a say?”. Below, the label “Five questions” and five boxes, one for each question in the guide.

noticias.titular: England's university regulator clarifies which AI practices fit its quality conditions and publishes the study behind them
noticias.entradilla: The Office for Students and Advance HE have put out a 48-page report, based on more than 300 students and staff, and a guide that translates its findings into registration conditions B1, B2 and B4.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diagram from left to right: a document labelled “Report” leads to an open book labelled “Guide B1 B2 B4”, which forks into two assessment lanes: a closed padlock labelled “Closed” and an open padlock labelled “Open”.

noticias.titular: A tool helps apply the order of priority in admissions to Valencian conservatoires
noticias.entradilla: José Luis Miralles Bono has created a website with diagrams, an age calculator and Excel templates for applying Order 8/2026 in music and dance schools in the Valencian Community.
noticias.imagen_alt: Page titled “Prelación de acceso a conservatorio”, with a tab bar (Outline, Timeline, Step-by-step guide, Age, Reorientation, Definitions, Templates) and four collapsible blocks of allocations.

noticias.titular: A Catalan-language website tells the story of the spice trade from Marco Polo onwards with maps, games and questions
noticias.entradilla: “El comerç de les espècies” offers nine interactive chapters, designed, according to its author, for secondary school and sixth-form students.
noticias.imagen_alt: A route with nine points running from a ship, labelled “Marco Polo”, to a globe, labelled “Today”; above, the label “Nine chapters”.

noticias.titular: Terminal or app: teachers compare ways of working with a coding agent
noticias.entradilla: The group discussed whether the terminal offers more freedom than the graphical app, and concluded that it depends on the person and the task.
noticias.imagen_alt: Three icons labelled “Web”, “App” and “Terminal” whose lines converge on a single box labelled “Result”.

noticias.titular: Unreal Engine 5.9 Preview adds MCP so AI agents can create 3D environments
noticias.entradilla: Epic Games has released a preview version of the engine with AI features, all of them experimental.
noticias.imagen_alt: A terminal labelled “Agent” and a cube labelled “3D editor” joined by a double-headed arrow labelled “MCP”; beneath the cube, a red zigzag line and the label “Experimental”.

noticias.titular: Reloj EDUmind brings together timers for the classroom, group work and independent study
noticias.entradilla: Luis has created an installable web app with three timer modes, designed for managing time in class from nursery to vocational training.

noticias.titular: The European AI literacy framework expected in December arrived in June, with the PISA 2029 assessment in the background
noticias.entradilla: In November 2025, anyone looking for ways to teach critical thinking with artificial intelligence was pointed to a framework still in draft, with the final version announced for December. It arrived six months later.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diptych split by a vertical line. On the left, labelled “Nov. 2025”: a text document, “Draft”, and below it an empty dotted box. On the right, labelled “Today”: the same document, now with a check mark, “Version 1.0”, and below it a filled box that reads “PISA 2029”.

noticias.titular: Anthropic advises that, to keep Fable 5.2 responsible for an action, you should write “ask for approval…
noticias.entradilla: Anthropic advises that, to keep Fable 5.2 responsible for an action, you should write “ask for approval before deleting files” instead of “never delete files”, and reply with the specific instruction rather than a simple “go ahead”. It follows the guide the paper reported on.

noticias.titular: Claude Whiteboards and Sheets, in beta, and Claude Data, which replaces Dashboards, were announced on 10…
noticias.entradilla: Claude Whiteboards and Sheets, in beta, and Claude Data, which replaces Dashboards, were announced on 10 November and are available on all paid plans.

noticias.titular: The author of the school music bell has published their project on GitHub: an installation guide, a manual…
noticias.entradilla: The author of the school music bell has published their project on GitHub: an installation guide, a manual for the staff and the code, with an AGPL licence for the code and CC BY-SA 4.0 for the documentation.

noticias.titular: Three models draw an animal cell diagram in SVG with no content errors
noticias.entradilla: A teacher asked three advanced models for a diagram of an animal cell. None made content errors, and they put the reliability down to the vector format.
noticias.imagen_alt: A diagram of two paths starting from “Model”: one goes through “SVG code” and reaches an animal cell with a tick; the other goes through “Generator” and reaches another cell without one.

noticias.titular: Anthropic recommends telling Fable 5.2 the code is its own if you want it to reorganise it
noticias.entradilla: Anthropic's guide to Fable 5.2 explains that the model behaves differently depending on who is named as the owner of the code, at a cost in tokens.
noticias.imagen_alt: Two columns: on the left, two identical blocks of code and the labels “Adds” and “Under 10%”; on the right, a merge icon above a single block of code and the labels “Merges” and “75%”.

noticias.titular: A second video with Fable 5.2 adds an agent that checks the scientific content before generating it
noticias.entradilla: After the photosynthesis animation, the same teacher has made one on cellular respiration with a reviewing agent, and has translated the first into Catalan.
noticias.imagen_alt: A chain of five steps with arrows, labelled “Script”, “Reviewer”, “Images”, “Reviewer” and “Video”, with a magnifying glass at each review step.

noticias.titular: “Polvo eres”, a stop-motion animated short made with generative AI
noticias.entradilla: A member of the group has shared their first short film, a spoof of cute horror made with generative AI.
noticias.imagen_alt: Three consecutive frames of a stop-motion short in which a little dust monster moves from left to right; labels: “Stop-motion”, “Little dust monsters” and “AI-generated”.

noticias.titular: Eduvers brings together interactive Physics and Chemistry simulations and is preparing 3D virtual labs
noticias.entradilla: Its author is adding simulations to the website and announces that he will link 3D labs in the coming weeks.
noticias.imagen_alt: Three cards under the label “Simulations and labs”: the parabolic trajectory of a ball, “Physics”; a flask, “Chemistry”; and a 3D cube, “3D lab”.

noticias.titular: GPT-5.1 arrived in ChatGPT to amazement at its speed and did not last four months there
noticias.entradilla: In November 2025, people were struck by how quickly GPT-5.1, OpenAI’s “more conversational” model, arrived. By 11 March 2026 it had already disappeared from ChatGPT.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diptych split by a vertical line. On the left, labelled “Nov. 2025”, a chat bubble with lines of text and the label “GPT-5.1”. On the right, labelled “Today”, the same bubble but dashed and in blue, with the label “GPT-5.1” struck through and “Retired” below.

noticias.titular: A single prompt is enough for Fable 5.2 to produce a photosynthesis animation for sixth-form students
noticias.entradilla: With a single prompt, the model produced a square video with a natural voice aimed at sixth-form students. The author considers it good enough for class and speaks of a new way to create materials.
noticias.imagen_alt: A diagram from left to right: a message bubble labelled “One prompt” leads to a box with the console symbol labelled “Console”, which leads to a square screen with a leaf labelled “Square video”; above, a red clock labelled “45 min”.

noticias.titular: EduGems becomes EduPrompts because Google is replacing Gems with Skills
noticias.entradilla: The site with 174 prompts for schools changes its name and address. The prompts can still be copied into any other AI tool.
noticias.imagen_alt: At the top, a box labelled “EduGems” points to another labelled “EduPrompts”; below, a box “Gems” leads with a red arrow to another labelled “Skills”, and on the right a copy icon labelled “Copy”.

noticias.titular: A music-class app asks students to place the notes of a score on the stave
noticias.entradilla: Pentagrama Maestro, created by Iñaki Fernández, plays note by note and offers three levels and unlimited games.
noticias.imagen_alt: A stave with four rising notes, labelled “Stave”, and an arrow leading to a loudspeaker labelled “Listen”; below, three bars of increasing height labelled “3 levels”.

noticias.titular: Tribunator organises panels, rooms and timetables for a conservatoire's entrance exams
noticias.entradilla: José Luis Miralles Bono has created, with the help of Claude, a tool that plans who sits on each panel, in which room and at what time they examine, and checks for clashes before anything is published.
noticias.imagen_alt: Tribunator welcome screen with the tabs Home, Space, Time, Templates, Panels and Verification, and the buttons Start from scratch, Import data and Load example.

noticias.titular: Gemini’s formulas reached Google Docs as code; a year on, Docs still does not understand LaTeX
noticias.entradilla: In November 2025, Gemini was already writing and editing formulas in LaTeX, but when they were taken into Google Docs they arrived as code. A year on, Google’s word processor still cannot read LaTeX and the remedy is the same: an add-on or a separate editor.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diptych split by a vertical line. On the left, “Nov. 2025”: a Google Docs page with the formula turned into code braces, labelled “Code”. On the right, “Today”: the same page with the same “Code”, and a blue arrow pointing to a blue puzzle piece labelled “Add-on”, the remedy that is still needed.

noticias.titular: Someone who runs a Claude Code agent on their home NAS says it runs as a service with administrator…
noticias.entradilla: Someone who runs a Claude Code agent on their home NAS says it runs as a service with administrator permissions, and that it asks before deleting data, touching disks or opening ports. It continues the thread on home automation with agents.

noticias.titular: The website of the National Congress on Digitalisation in Education, held in Albacete on 5 and 6 November,…
noticias.entradilla: The website of the National Congress on Digitalisation in Education, held in Albacete on 5 and 6 November, offers access to the broadcast of the talks, according to the group. (In Spanish.)

noticias.titular: Anthropic is giving plans that include Fable between one and three usage-limit resets, depending on the…
noticias.entradilla: Anthropic is giving plans that include Fable between one and three usage-limit resets, depending on the length of the subscription, which can be used until 8 March 2027; Pro gets one, only until 16 November. The model is Fable 5.2.

noticias.titular: Anthropic launches Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2, the latter only for verified organisations
noticias.entradilla: The company announces two versions of the same model: Fable 5.2, with safeguards and no prior verification, and Mythos 5.2, only for verified organisations.
noticias.imagen_alt: A diagram of a trunk, “Claude 5.2”, that forks into two branches: “Fable 5.2”, which leads to a group of people labelled “No verification”, and “Mythos 5.2”, which leads to a padlocked closed door labelled “Verified”.

noticias.titular: A group thread uses coding agents to control home automation
noticias.entradilla: A thread in the group collects uses of agents such as Claude Code or Antigravity to run the television, music and the Home Assistant configuration, with control of privacy as a condition.
noticias.imagen_alt: A diagram in which a box, “Agent”, points to a code document labelled “Configuration”, which points to a house labelled “Home Assistant”; below, a red padlock labelled “No passwords”.

noticias.titular: Two Catalan-language apps by David Cordones: a letters and numbers game and a reception classroom
noticias.entradilla: Xifres i Lletres trains vocabulary and mental arithmetic by age; Aula d'Acollida Digital offers initial language support.
noticias.imagen_alt: Two panels: on the left, a calculator and three boxes labelled “Xifres i Lletres”; on the right, a translation icon labelled “Aula d'Acollida”; below, a dashed box labelled “Open source”.

noticias.titular: How “Buzz” was shot: Claude, Blender via MCP, a virtual reality headset and Seedance
noticias.entradilla: Its director details the process behind the short film the paper covered yesterday, and warns that it is expensive in credits.
noticias.imagen_alt: Four steps in a row joined by arrows: a code document labelled “App with Claude”, a 3D cube labelled “Blender and MCP”, a headset labelled “Filming in VR” and a clapperboard labelled “Seedance”; a red arrow points at the last one with the label “Costly in credits”.

noticias.titular: A website promotes Belsetán, an endangered Aragonese variety, with games and classroom worksheets
noticias.entradilla: “El aprendiz del pastor” brings together history, texts, games and teaching materials on the language of the Bielsa valley.
noticias.imagen_alt: A mountain labelled “Bielsa Valley” leads to an open book labelled “Belsetán”, from which two arrows come out: one to a pair of dice labelled “Games” and another to a document labelled “Worksheets”.

noticias.titular: The open model that was “checkmating” the giants: a year on, Kimi is almost three times bigger and still behind
noticias.entradilla: In November 2025, people were sharing that a Chinese open-weights model, Kimi K2 Thinking, beat GPT-5 on some tests. Today Kimi K3, from the same family, is almost three times bigger, but its maker admits it does not match the best closed models.

noticias.titular: A free connector for Windows sends sensor data from a micro:bit board, over USB, to the ThingSpeak…
noticias.entradilla: A free connector for Windows sends sensor data from a micro:bit board, over USB, to the ThingSpeak platform, useful for weather stations or vegetable gardens with charts.

noticias.titular: Google AI Studio now lets you build apps with maps, place data and routes from Google Maps Platform…
noticias.entradilla: Google AI Studio now lets you build apps with maps, place data and routes from Google Maps Platform without leaving the tool; with the free demo key, with no billing, the limit is 100 calls a day per API.

noticias.titular: An AI detector's percentage opens a conversation with the student, but does not prove they copied
noticias.entradilla: A post on the blog “Familias con inteligencia” asks what to do when a detector flags the work of a student who says they wrote it themselves, and suggests backing the percentage up with evidence of the process.
noticias.imagen_alt: A set of scales tipped to the right: on the lighter left pan, a card labelled “Detector 87%”; on the heavier right pan, another labelled “Drafts”, “Versions” and “Oral explanation”. Between the two pans, a magnifying glass and the label “A person decides”.

noticias.titular: A short film is shot inside virtual reality and finished with AI
noticias.entradilla: Raül Torres shares a preview of “Buzz”, a short film whose shots he directs with a virtual reality headset on sets created in Blender.
noticias.imagen_alt: A diagram in three steps joined by arrows: a 3D set labelled “Set in Blender”, a virtual reality headset labelled “Camera in VR” and a clapperboard labelled “Final with AI”. Below, in a dashed box, what is still to come: “Colour, sound, editing”.

noticias.titular: A planner lets schools build the school-year calendar from the official Valencian Community one or from scratch
noticias.entradilla: Calendari, created by José Luis Miralles Bono with the help of Claude, lets a school build its academic calendar in the browser, starting from the official Valencian one or from scratch.
noticias.imagen_alt: Home screen of Calendari with four cards: official calendar of the Valencian Community, create a new calendar, import from a file and view published calendars.

noticias.titular: A word cloud with a “backend” in a single prompt: today Claude’s new artifacts save data without being published
noticias.entradilla: In November 2025, a word cloud built with Claude stored everyone’s votes from a single prompt. Today the new artifacts save data without needing to be published.
noticias.imagen_alt: A word cloud with a “backend” in a single prompt: today Claude’s new artifacts save data without being published

noticias.titular: The BBC tested AI toys for young children: one of the soft toys replied “I can't help with killing you”…
noticias.entradilla: The BBC tested AI toys for young children: one of the soft toys replied “I can't help with killing you” after misunderstanding a question. British MPs are asking retailers to withdraw these toys before Black Friday.

noticias.titular: Juan José de Haro has expanded his article with the idea that different agents (Claude Code, Codex,…
noticias.entradilla: Juan José de Haro has expanded his article with the idea that different agents (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity) can share a common body of knowledge that all of them can add to, as the paper reported on four-layer memory. It only works with agents installed on the computer, not with web versions.

noticias.antetitulo: AI and age in the classroom
noticias.titular: The age for using AI in class depends on three different rules: those of the companies, the law and the education authorities
noticias.entradilla: Each service’s terms, data protection law and some education authorities set different ages for using artificial intelligence, and they are often confused. This report explains what each says as of 6 November 2026, why research asks us to swap the question of age for the question of purpose, and how a primary or secondary teacher can decide which tool to use, with which account, and who operates it.
noticias.imagen_alt: Infographic on an age ruler from 0 to 18, with marks at 13, 14 and 18, in three blocks. “Companies”: “OpenAI and Microsoft: from 13”, with a line from 13 to 18; “Anthropic: from 18”, with a dot at 18; and “Gemini with a school account: all ages”, with a bar from 0 to 18. “Data law”: “Own consent: from 14”, with a dashed line up to 14 and a solid one after it; and “At school, no consent needed: educational function”, with a bar from 0 to 18. “Some education authorities”: “Catalonia: the teacher operates the AI”, with a red line up to 14, and “From 14: inform, authorisation advisable”, with a line from 14; and “Basque Country: chatbots from 13”, with a cross before 13 and a line after it; and “Murcia: autonomous access from 3rd-year ESO”, with a dashed line up to 14 and a solid one after it. At the foot, “What for? Which account? Who operates it?”.

noticias.titular: Anthropic proposes organising AI agents' memory into four layers with a periodic review
noticias.entradilla: An Anthropic research text describes how to give an agent memory between sessions, and a teacher in the group has adapted their own system to that idea and explains it in an article with instructions.
noticias.imagen_alt: Four stacked layers, from top to bottom labelled “Profile”, “Notes”, “Wiki” and “Conversations”, and a curved blue arrow rising from the conversations to the profile, next to a moon labelled “Night review”.

noticias.titular: Holmio turns the periodic table into a daily detective game
noticias.entradilla: Each day brings a new case with 118 suspects, the chemical elements, and six accusations to find the culprit; according to its author, no registration is required.
noticias.imagen_alt: A grid of squares imitating the periodic table, with the label “Case of the day” above and “One case per element” below; a blue magnifying glass points at one square. On the right, six circles, one with a red cross, labelled “6 accusations”.

noticias.titular: A calculator splits the working week of peripatetic teachers across several schools in the Valencian Community
noticias.entradilla: Itinerancias, created by José Luis Miralles Bono, calculates how the non-teaching hours are divided among the schools of a teacher who is shared between them, according to the teaching hours they give in each one. It opens in the browser, in Spanish and Valencian, and also offers an Excel spreadsheet with the same calculation.
noticias.imagen_alt: The “Tablas” tab of Itinerancias, with a selector for non-teaching hours and expandable sections on proportional and block allocation.

noticias.titular: Incluxat brings the guidance from educational psychology reports to the conservatoire
noticias.entradilla: An AI assistant adapts to music education guidance designed for mainstream schools, with its supporting documentation published so it can be reviewed.
noticias.imagen_alt: A document labelled “Report”, an arrow to a chat bubble labelled “Assistant” and another arrow to a piano labelled “Conservatoire”.

noticias.titular: From the character who warped within eight seconds to models that keep them the same from scene to scene
noticias.entradilla: In November 2025, animating a character with Veo 3 meant cutting the clip before it stopped looking like itself. Today Google promises to keep it consistent from scene to scene.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diptych split by a vertical line. On the left, “Nov. 2025”: an “8 s” bar with one character at the start and, after the cut, another drawn warped and in dashes. On the right, “Today”: a longer “15 s” bar with the same character repeated three times, identical, in blue.

noticias.titular: Teachers debate whether families’ authorisation is needed to use AI with students
noticias.entradilla: One school has limited generative AI with its students because some families did not authorise it; other views hold that simply informing them is enough. The rules are clear: families must be informed, but between 14 and 18 their consent is not needed unless the tool requires it.
noticias.imagen_alt: Infographic in two panels. On the left, “Under 14”, with a whiteboard and the label “In Catalonia, the teacher operates the AI”. On the right, “14 to 18”, with four rows: a megaphone, “Inform: always”; a pair of scales, “Consent: not needed”; a document with a tick, “Authorisation: advised in Catalonia”; and a document with a pencil, “Compulsory if the tool requires it”. Below, a band with a crossed-out person: “If a family objects, it only affects their child”.

noticias.titular: A teacher replaces the school siren with a musical bell managed from a spreadsheet
noticias.entradilla: David Cordones says that, with the help of generative AI, he built a school bell on a Raspberry Pi that staff change from Google Sheets.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diagram from left to right: a spreadsheet labelled “Spreadsheet”, an arrow to a chip labelled “Raspberry Pi” and another arrow to a loudspeaker labelled “PA system”. Below the chip, a music file labelled “MP3 folder” and an arrow pointing up to the Raspberry Pi.

noticias.titular: An auction of phrases, a guide to responsible vibe coding, chemistry, music and illustrated books: new in the repository
noticias.entradilla: Since 27 October, the Vibe Coding Educativo resource repository has added sixteen resources: ten have already had their own article in the paper and six are presented here, two by Juan José de Haro, one by Felip Sarroca, one by FiQuiPedia and two by Samuel Soriano.
noticias.imagen_alt: Home page of Subasta de frases, with the buttons “Crear una actividad” and “Unirse a una sesión” and three cards: Conocimiento, Valores y prioridades, Roles y conceptos.

noticias.titular: Anthropic bans sustained, gratuitous abuse of its models in its usage policy
noticias.entradilla: The update, published on 8 October 2026, takes effect on 12 November and will be enforced only in extreme cases.
noticias.imagen_alt: A horizontal bar divided by a red line. On the left, labelled “Allowed”, three speech bubbles: two labelled “Frustration” and “Disagreement”. To the right of the line, a blue speech bubble labelled “Repeated cruelty” and, below it, a calendar labelled “From 12 Nov”.

noticias.titular: EDUmind MiClase, an open-source teacher’s notebook, keeps data on the device and syncs without its own server
noticias.entradilla: Its author explained in the group how it syncs two devices and which features he says he has added to assess under the LOMLOE.
noticias.imagen_alt: A laptop labelled “Laptop” and a mobile phone labelled “Phone”, joined by a two-way arrow with a wifi symbol and the label “Same wifi”. Below, a server drawn with a dashed line and crossed out with a red cross, labelled “No server”.

noticias.titular: Google Flow charges credits per second for Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash videos
noticias.entradilla: Flow’s official help page sets out the cost of generating and editing clips with the model, which can already be chosen in the app, according to comments in the group.
noticias.imagen_alt: Chart with two bars: the short one, labelled “360p”, has “1 credit/s” above it and the tall one, labelled “720p”, has “3 credits/s”. On the right, a film clapperboard and, beneath some coins, the label “50 a day”.

noticias.titular: NotebookLM presentations, once impossible to tweak, can now be revised slide by slide
noticias.entradilla: A year ago, anyone wanting an editable presentation had to leave NotebookLM. Today the tool, which no longer even goes by that name, makes slides, amends them on request and exports them to PowerPoint.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diptych split by a vertical line. On the left, “Nov. 2025”: a slide with a play triangle and a padlock, labelled “Video locked”. On the right, “Today”: the same slide, in blue, with lines of text and a pencil, labelled “Editable”.

noticias.titular: Luis Vilela Acuña released the open-source code of Liga de Valores, his app for school Physical Education…
noticias.entradilla: Luis Vilela Acuña released the open-source code of Liga de Valores, his app for school Physical Education leagues in which fair play, refereeing and the stands also score, with an installer to run it on the school's own network without an external server. He presents it in an article in the Revista Española de Educación Física y Deportes.

noticias.titular: Antigravity, Google's agent-based programming environment, has run cloud projects managed from the browser…
noticias.entradilla: Antigravity, Google's agent-based programming environment, has run cloud projects managed from the browser since version 2.29 (3 November), instead of on the user's own computer; according to its changelog, it is rolling out to Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers.

noticias.titular: Gemini lets users export their interactive apps to a Google Sites site with one click
noticias.entradilla: Google has made it possible to publish an interactive app created in the Gemini app as a Google Sites site. The group discussed how useful it really is for teachers.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diagram: a speech bubble labelled “Gemini” leads, via an arrow labelled “One click”, to a web page with a padlock labelled “Private draft”; a second dashed arrow, crossed out in red, points to a dashed box labelled “Existing site”.

noticias.titular: MechSimulator brings together free mechanical engineering simulators that run in the browser
noticias.entradilla: A group member highlighted this website of 2D and 3D simulations as an example of what one person can achieve.
noticias.imagen_alt: A browser window with a cogwheel, a ruler and a spanner, and a bending curve beneath them, labelled “In the browser”; an arrow leads to a grid of dots, one highlighted in blue, labelled “150+”.

noticias.titular: Fil i compte lets teachers prepare printable maths problem sheets in Catalan and Spanish, with an answer key
noticias.entradilla: A bank of 252 problems lets primary and lower secondary teachers pick problems, put them in order and print the worksheet or save it as a PDF.
noticias.imagen_alt: Screen of the problem bank with level, difficulty and content filters on the left and problem cards in Catalan on the right.

noticias.titular: Google unveils Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, which generates and edits videos of up to 15 seconds
noticias.entradilla: The new version of Google’s video model extends clip length and allows clips to be refined over several turns. The announcement was shared in EduMedia-IAG.
noticias.imagen_alt: Two bars compare duration: “Omni 1.1: 10 s” and, longer, “Omni 1.2: 15 s”. Below, three video cameras joined by arrows labelled “Turn by turn” show the clip being refined step by step, and a tag labelled “SynthID” marks the output.

noticias.titular: The XTEC page on AI links to the 2024 document as its guidance, with the note “Actualització prevista:…
noticias.entradilla: The XTEC page on AI links to the 2024 document as its guidance, with the note “Actualització prevista: des.26” (update expected: December 2026), and does not include the 45 guidelines from Catalonia that the paper reported.

noticias.titular: OpenAI unveiled Images 2.6, which, according to its announcement, speeds up image generation, allows GIFs…
noticias.entradilla: OpenAI unveiled Images 2.6, which, according to its announcement, speeds up image generation, allows GIFs to be created in ChatGPT and improves editing. It was shared in EduMedia-IAG; OpenAI’s page would not load, so the official description was read from its preview.

noticias.titular: Raül Torres, author of the virtual camera for Blender that the paper reported, posted an example made with…
noticias.entradilla: Raül Torres, author of the virtual camera for Blender that the paper reported, posted an example made with his VirtuCam tool and a Meta Quest 3 headset: five shots recorded in VR served as the camera reference for Seedance 2.5. According to him, the model followed the cuts almost frame by frame, although it added shots that were never recorded.

noticias.titular: A tool turns a mobile phone and VR headset into a virtual camera for Blender
noticias.entradilla: Raül Torres describes how, with help from Claude, he built a system that records real camera movements in Blender to then guide an AI video generator.
noticias.imagen_alt: Three-step diagram from left to right: a phone with a red dot and the label REC, under the caption “Phone or headset”; an arrow to a 3D cube with a camera at the end of a dotted path, under the caption “Blender scene”; and another arrow to a video frame with a landscape, under the caption “AI video”.

noticias.titular: An open project offers 54 interactive 3D science lessons for upper secondary school, in Chinese
noticias.entradilla: Tongjiang Lab brings together physics, chemistry, biology and geography lessons in HTML files that work offline; in the group it was pointed to as an example of what will be possible with AI.
noticias.imagen_alt: A bar divided into four sections of proportional width, under the label “54 lessons”; above each section an icon: an atom over “Physics”, a flask over “Chemistry” (the longest section, in blue), a DNA helix over “Biology” (the shortest) and a globe over “Geography”.

noticias.titular: A tool randomly forms the home and expert groups for the Jigsaw technique
noticias.entradilla: “Rompecabezas – Técnica Jigsaw” takes a list of students and subtopics and splits them into balanced groups. It opens in the browser and is available in five languages.
noticias.imagen_alt: Start screen with a box for typing students’ names, four colour-coded subtopics, a general topic field and the “Formar grupos” button.

noticias.titular: A block-based programming editor, built on TurboWarp and compatible with Scratch, for learning to code
noticias.entradilla: EduTicTac Blocs is a visual programming environment compatible with Scratch projects and with classroom templates; according to its website, it has no advertising or trackers.
noticias.imagen_alt: Example project with the “Ver dentro” button and the stage with its flag, pause and stop controls, a green start notice and the “Empieza con una plantilla” and “Explora la galería” buttons.

noticias.titular: Raül Torres shared in EduMedia-IAG a video-game-style walk through Girona made with Claude, with places…
noticias.entradilla: Raül Torres shared in EduMedia-IAG a video-game-style walk through Girona made with Claude, with places taken from the real map and time travel from the Palaeolithic to 2026. It runs from the web and no public link is available.

noticias.titular: Teachers debate Google’s announcement that switches off AI and search by default in school accounts
noticias.entradilla: Google has announced that Gemini and Google Search will be switched off in primary and secondary school student accounts until administrators turn them on. In the groups, the news sparked a discussion about who decides how AI is used in a school.
noticias.imagen_alt: On the left, an all-or-nothing master switch crossed out with a red X; on the right, four individual switches (Gemini, Notebook, Classroom and Search), two switched on in blue and two off.

noticias.titular: A gamified activity teaches the gravitational field through nine orbital missions
noticias.entradilla: “Misiones orbitales”, by El profe de la bata, asks students to create an astronaut and complete nine missions using interactive simulators. The practice version runs in the browser, with no accounts.
noticias.imagen_alt: A planet surrounded by a blue elliptical orbit with nine dots, one per mission (“9 missions”), and on the right three stars labelled “All the stars”, earned with an error below 5% (“Error < 5%”).

noticias.titular: An MIT committee calls for rethinking aims, assessment and the in-person community in the face of an AI that can already do almost any written work
noticias.entradilla: The ad hoc committee of the Massachusetts Institute of Technology proposes eight principles and a set of recommendations for adapting university teaching to generative AI.
noticias.imagen_alt: A diagram with a top bar of eight principles from which three arrows lead to three columns: educational processes (oral exam, portfolio), community (a group of people) and support structures (organisation chart and tools).

noticias.titular: A Catalan-language lab lets students practise inorganic formulation with questions, hints and challenges
noticias.entradilla: “Laboratori de formulació”, created by Felip Sarroca i Gil, offers inorganic nomenclature exercises for Secondary and Upper Secondary students, with three working modes and a progress counter.
noticias.imagen_alt: Screen of the Practica mode with the question “Quina és la fórmula de: sulfur de bari” and four options (BaS, Ba2S2, BaCl2, PbCl2), hint and solution buttons, and on the right the list of activity types.

noticias.titular: FoQo generates organic formulation tests and gives the name of a drawn structure
noticias.entradilla: FiQuiPedia’s app lets users practise organic chemistry nomenclature with configurable tests and a tool that goes from formula to name.
noticias.imagen_alt: Start screen titled “Formulación Química” with the Tests, F → N and Panel buttons, IUPAC and CAS logos, links to libraries and a row of functional groups.

noticias.titular: A Geography teacher uses Gemini to build a counter of births and deaths around the world
noticias.entradilla: “Pulso Demográfico Mundial en Tiempo Real”, by Ricardo Chao Prieto, simulates in real time the births and deaths in each country, based on the UN’s population projections for 2026.
noticias.imagen_alt: A globe in the centre with a births counter on the left, marked with a blue plus, and a deaths counter on the right, with a minus, and a red arrow pointing up to indicate net growth.

noticias.titular: In EduMedia-IAG, members explained how to use MotionVideo’s skills: you install the skill in the AI,…
noticias.entradilla: In EduMedia-IAG, members explained how to use MotionVideo’s skills: you install the skill in the AI, invoke it and give it the instruction with the details of the video you want to create. Each example video on the site comes with its prompt, as the piece of 3 November reported.

noticias.titular: In the United States, the Los Angeles school district blocked students’ access to generative AI on their…
noticias.entradilla: In the United States, the Los Angeles school district blocked students’ access to generative AI on their devices in September, and the FCC is reviewing E-Rate subsidies for school internet connections amid the row over screen time. They were shared in the group as context for Google’s announcement.

noticias.titular: A teacher recommends building infographics in HTML and SVG rather than as generated images
noticias.entradilla: A member of Vibe Coding Educativo argues that, to illustrate concepts, AI should generate SVG shapes and icons in an HTML page, with generated images kept for when they are pedagogically necessary.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diagram in which an “Idea” splits into two paths: one ends in a crossed-out opaque block, the “Generated image”, and the other in an infographic of shapes and icons, “HTML and SVG”, from which two advantages branch off: “Screen reader” and “Light and dark”.

noticias.titular: An MIT report, from August, calls for rethinking teaching and assessment in the age of AI
noticias.entradilla: The committee set up by MIT to study the use of AI in teaching, learning and research training recommends AI-aware educational processes and a review of assessments and policies.
noticias.imagen_alt: A “Report” from which three branches extend, each with its own icon: a sheet with a tick, “Assessment and rules”; two people, “People and campus”; and two arrows in a circle, “Continuous improvement”.

noticias.titular: Teachers as designers of learning are at the heart of the debate on AI in the classroom
noticias.entradilla: After a conference on AI and education, members ask whether teachers stop being a source of information and how to prevent students from delegating their reasoning.
